sentences.en: The advance reviews of the new film are very favorable.
sentences.zh: 新电影的早期评论非常积极。

sentences.en: Thanks to the favorable wind, we soon reached the island.
sentences.zh: 多亏了顺风，我们很快就到达了那个岛屿。

sentences.en: Almost all of the reviews of the play were favorable.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有的戏剧评论都很正面。

senses.zh: 有利的，有助于的；赞同的，赞成的；顺利的，良好的
